name: LEGO Group
rootCause: According to a report by Cointelegraph, the homepage of toy manufacturer LEGO Group was hacked on October 5th local time, briefly displaying a "LEGO Coin" token scam. The fraudulent token was present on the LEGO Group's website for approximately 75 minutes before being removed.
